description: STATUS computation (loop.sh:40-44) is a sequence of full overwrites, not a composition. If HEAL is non-empty it unconditionally clobbers any 'EARNING' string already computed in the same wake (line 44 runs last and wins). Concretely: if LM Stripe subs are genuinely > 0 (real earning) in the same wake that Capafy auth happens to be down, the human/agent-facing STATUS line reports ONLY 'HEAL-NEEDED — CAPAFY-AUTH-DOWN...' -- the fact that real revenue also exists this wake is dropped from the one field most likely to be skimmed (the raw lm_active_paid_subs field is still printed separately, but the narrative STATUS text hides it).

evidence.snippet:
if ...; then STATUS="EARNING (Capafy net \$$CAP_REV) — grow it"; fi
if ...; then STATUS="EARNING (LM $LM_SUBS active subs) — grow it"; fi
[ -n "$HEAL" ] && STATUS="HEAL-NEEDED — $HEAL"

fix: Compose STATUS to reflect both concerns when both apply, e.g. 'EARNING (LM 3 subs) + HEAL-NEEDED (Capafy down)', instead of a single winner-takes-all string.
